visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera captures a wide view of a market stall named "禾味肉圓" located in an open indoor market with fluorescent overhead lighting. An employee wearing a dark vest over a light shirt, a white helmet, and a blue face mask is seen working behind a service counter. Wooden tables and red-framed stools are set in the foreground near a metal pillar. (2) A person wearing blue latex gloves lifts a large metal steamer lid to reveal dozens of translucent, white Taiwanese meatballs arranged in rows. A metal ladle is used to scoop a thick, dark brown sauce followed by a vibrant red sauce into a small floral-patterned porcelain bowl. The setting is a functional kitchen area with stainless steel pots and various ingredient containers. (3) The camera zooms in to a macro shot of a meatball on a silver spoon, showcasing its gelatinous outer layer coated in red sauce and garnished with fresh green cilantro. The inner filling of seasoned ground meat is clearly visible. The lighting is bright and direct, highlighting the moist textures of the food. (4) The employee prepares a soup version, placing two meatballs into a stainless steel bowl and adding white pepper, garlic paste, and chopped cilantro. A ladle pours steaming clear broth into the bowl from a large pot. The background shows stacks of clean bowls and various yellow condiment bottles. (5) Thick brown noodles are scooped from a large pot into a bowl, followed by a rice dumpling (zongzi) being drizzled with dark sauce and sprinkled with light brown peanut powder. A fork pulls apart the rice dumpling to reveal a piece of braised meat inside. (6) A bowl of savory rice cake is presented, topped with cilantro and chopped radish bits. The camera transitions through a series of close-ups showing the various dishes together on a dark wooden table. Finally, the scene returns to a wide shot of the stall under the "中興市場" sign, with people walking by in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, high-tempo acoustic BGM featuring rhythmic guitar strumming and a clean electronic drum beat. A male narrator introduces the location in an energetic, high-pitched tone with clear articulation. Faint background market chatter is present at a low volume. (2) A metallic "clink" sound occurs as a lid is handled, followed by the soft sloshing of sauces being ladled into a bowl. The narrator continues speaking rapidly, describing the food preparation process with a bright and positive emotional valence. (3) A subtle digital "whoosh" transition sound effect bridges two scenes. The sound of metal utensils clicking against bowls is audible underneath the steady BGM. The narrator's pitch rises slightly during descriptive highlights. (4) Distinct scraping sounds of a fork against a plate are heard during the close-up of a rice dumpling. The BGM maintains a consistent intensity, while the narrator provides a high-arousal closing recommendation. The track concludes with a final drum hit and a sharp fade out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy food recommendation vlog for a 50-year-old stall in Kaohsiung's Cijin District. By combining fast-paced visual montages of food preparation and textures with an enthusiastic vocal narration, it aims to entice viewers to visit the location to try their specialty meatballs, soup, and noodles.
